inv.desc_en:
SOUNDPROOFED premises for SALE, with a permanent license and terrace permit for 4 or 5 tables, set up for a bar, eatery, restaurant, etc. It is currently rented with a monthly income of €1,500 and a remaining contract of 3 more years. It is in a prime area of Valencia, right between Paseo de la Alameda and Avenida de Francia, a very lively area day and night. It has 83 m² plus a loft with a storage room and a bathroom. On the main floor, there is another bathroom for people with reduced mobility, a pantry, the dining room, a spacious kitchen, and a bar-style counter. The floor is marble, walls are smooth, it has hot and cold air conditioning, the main door is aluminum and a glass front of about 4 m, a motorized roller shutter with a new motor, a luminous advertising banner on the facade, and a 4 m sign for new vinyl (illuminated).

The advertisement is for informational purposes only and is not contractual; the data we provide may contain errors.
For more details, contact:
GRUPO INMO21 real estate agency.
If you want to sell or rent your house, with more than 10 years of experience and a methodology that integrates traditional consulting, GRUPO INMO21 guarantees the sale of your house in the shortest possible time and at the best price. Contact us, we will visit you in less than 24 hours and value your house for free.
Purchase and sale costs and real estate agency fees are not included in the price.
